column3: Resume wt/traffic-motion (4e5b1307): wheel spin, steering, brake dive / roll on kinematic traffic cars. 39 checks were passing, no stills pushed, no final gate. Merge origin/main, finish, gate, shoot before/after stills of a street queue and a turning car (STREET=queue on still_shot.gd and a chase view), push wt/traffic-motion and shots/traffic-motion.

Resume wt/skyline-glass-day (89b1a970; shots/skyline-glass-day 1719773f): the downtown towers' curtain glass by day seen from 100-600 m reads flat / wrong. Merge origin/main, finish the look (the sky and the facing towers mirrored at the right brightness, floor-by-floor variety, nothing stripy or blown out), gate, before/after stills from the golden_aerial and downtown_aerial refcams plus a 300 m street-level view, push.

Resume wt/web-hero-rain (ba9a2284): the hero's tracksuit reads BLUE in rain on the WEB build only (native is fine). Cause not found yet. Suspects: wet_surface.gdshaderinc / hero_cloth.gdshader on the Compatibility renderer (colour space: cs_in on a texture that is raw there; a source_color uniform decoded twice; a vec3 vs Color uniform), the web's half-float instance data, a sampler over the WebGL2 cap. Reproduce with the opengl3_es driver or tools/webshot (CLAUDE.md web notes), fix the cause, prove with a before/after webshot in rain, gate, push.

Resume wt/paving-aliasing (7115dec9; shots/paving-aliasing aa9dde2b): red brick / herringbone pavement and forecourt paving shimmer with moire at eye level. Forecourt and pavement fixes were pushed, its gate was running. Merge origin/main, make sure every paved pattern (lot_ground, kerbs, plaza paving, the replica's walks, the Esplanade) fades its pattern to its average under about two pixels (fwidth-based, like the vinyl lettering), gate, before/after stills at eye level 2 m and 20 m, push.

Resume wt/night-flight (9194e756; shots/night-flight 2f0059fe): the night city from 150-800 m up (the aerial a player sees jumping or flying): the far lamp glow, lit windows, traffic streams, the light dome, dark hills, the sea. Merge origin/main, finish, gate, before/after stills at 150, 400 and 800 m over downtown and midtown at 22:00, push.

The wet road at night mirrors the lit windows as a regular GRID OF SQUARES across the carriageway (road.gdshader mirrored_city(), the night street refcam street_night). A real wet street shows long vertical streaks under lamps and shop fronts, broken up by the asphalt's micro relief, sharp only in standing water. Rework mirrored_city() so the reflection is streaks and smears (stretched along the view direction, varying by a per-pixel roughness field, the shop fronts dominant, no visible cell grid), keep Forward+'s SSR blend (mirror_forward) and the dry road bit-identical. Prove with the street_night refcam before/after and a small Forward+ scene under lavapipe.

The golden-hour review for 05:00-08:30: sunrise over the east range, the marine layer burning off, long cool shadows, the east sun low across the basin. Shoot the street_noon, golden_aerial, hills and beach cameras at 06:15, 07:00 and 08:00 (refcams_shot.gd takes the hour) before and after. Fix: the sky's dawn palette (sunset_sky / sky.gdshader: a cooler, pinker dawn than the dusk, less smog), the grade (HourGrade's weights at dawn), the street lamps going off at the right time, dew / morning haze, the sun's colour at 5 degrees up. Nothing at noon or at night may change (bit-identical).

Reference camera street_noon (Flower at Olympic, downtown, eye height, 12:00 clear): what reads fake first at eye level at noon. Likely: the pavement and kerb up close, the parked cars' tyres and their contact, the building bases and doors, people's faces and walks, the traffic's spacing, the sky's brightness against the street. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera street_night (Flower at Olympic, 21:30, rain): what reads fake first at night in the rain. Coordinate with nobody: wet-road-mirror owns road.gdshader's mirrored_city(), so leave that function alone and work on everything else in the frame: lamp halos and their colour, lit windows and signs, the people's wet clothes and umbrellas, the rain's visibility, car lights on the wet road, the sky's glow. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera sunset (the Esplanade down the coast, 18:36, clear): what reads fake at sunset on the coast. The sea's colour and glitter, the sand, the bluff and its houses, the sky's bands, the far headland, the lamps coming on. Batch 25 (golden-hour review) just landed here: start from its stills on shots/golden-hour-review. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera golden_aerial (downtown from the south-west, 140 m up, 18:18 clear): what reads fake in the aerial at golden hour. The towers' glass (skyline-glass-day owns the curtain glass by DAY; you own the low-sun look and everything else), the roofs, the far city's handover, the haze, the freeway, the hills behind. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera downtown_aerial (the civic centre, 60 m up, 12:30 clear): what reads fake in the civic centre from 60 m. City hall and its park, the roofs and roof plant, the street grid's paint, the parked cars, the trees' crowns from above, the LOD handover a few blocks out. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera beach (the waterline at z 800, 14:00 clear): what reads fake on the beach at two in the afternoon. The sand's grain and footprints, the swash, the people (BeachFigures) and their towels, the pier, the surf's foam, the sky over the sea, the bike path. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera hills (the front range from 260 m, 15:00 clear): what reads fake in the hills. The ground's stands and rock, the shrub clumps' silhouettes, the estates, the fire roads, the far ranges' haze, the sign ridge. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras. rock-outcrops and hill-ground-3 landed in wave 3: start from their HANDOFF sections.

Reference camera freeway (the 110's deck by downtown, 13:00 clear): what reads fake on the freeway. The deck's concrete and joints (freeway-closeup landed), the traffic's spacing and speed, the barriers, signs and lights, the towers behind, the ramps. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera macarthur (MacArthur Park from the south, 120 m up, 11:00 clear): what reads fake over the park. The lake's water, the lawns and walks, the trees from above, the crowd, the camps across the street, the boulevard traffic, the midtown roofs round it. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

Reference camera pier_night (the pier and its wheel from the beach, 21:00 clear): what reads fake at the pier at night. The wheel's LEDs and their glow, the lamps' reflections in the wet sand and sea, the crowd on the deck, the sky, the bonfires, the far lights up the coast. Fix the worst three to five, hold the other nine cameras.

The hero at arm's length, second pass (owner: GTA 6): the tracksuit's cloth (velour sheen, folds at the elbows and knees in motion, the hood / collar), the hands (fingers on the gun, the skin), the face (hero-face-2 landed: finish what still reads waxy: the lips, the eyes' wetness, the brows), the hair cards' edges. Judge with tools/glshot/hero_shot.gd on both renderers and a small Forward+ scene. No new bones.

The hero's movement animation: walk / run / sprint transitions, a start and a stop animation, a turn in place, the strafe, the lean into a sprint turn, the land-and-run blend. The clips are Quaternius UAL (tools/hero/hero_clips.gd retargets them; add clips there). Blend trees in Avatar; no pop between clips; the gun stays in the hand through every move (HeroMotion's rules). Prove with tools/glshot/hero_moves_shot.gd strips.

The crowd at 2-6 m, third pass: the garments' edges and seams, the shoes (one flat slab today: real trainers / boots with laces and soles on the crowd rigs through tools/crowd), hands with a thumb (no finger bones: a better hand mesh and texture), hair card edges, the walk's foot slide. Judge with crowd_lineup.gd and a Forward+ small scene.

Cars at arm's length: panel gaps and shut lines on every lofted body, door handles, mirrors with glass, badges (CarDetail landed: finish), wheel arches' inner lining, brake discs and calipers through the spokes, exhaust tips, the underbody not a flat plane. tools/make_road_cars.py / make_more_cars.py / make_cars_3.py. Keep the far twin's cost; measure with car_shot.gd and geo_count.

Traffic that reads alive at eye level: cars that creep at a red, drivers' heads that turn, brake lights that flicker on and off in a queue, a bus pulling out with its indicator, cars giving way to a pedestrian mid-crossing, a car waiting to turn left across traffic, cars dodging a wreck. On TrafficManager + TrafficAI's hooks only; coordinate with traffic-motion (which owns wheel spin / steering / body motion of kinematic cars): do not touch those.

The crowd's flow: people walk in pairs and small groups, step round each other and round props without stopping dead, slow in a crowd, cross at the lights in a bunch, walk out of shop doors and into them, wait at the kerb for a car to pass. The Pedestrian ring walk + CrowdFeet are the base; local avoidance (a cheap reciprocal velocity step on the near crowd only), group walking (two or three sharing a leader) and door traffic (StreetErrands has shop doors).

Shop fronts at arm's length: the shop door's frame and glass, the threshold, door mats, menus taped to glass, hanging signs' chains, awnings' fabric sag and stripes, planters by the door, a sandwich board, lit interiors through the glass at the right brightness at noon (not black). ShopfrontKit + building.gdshader + FacadeStreet; keep the kit's slice rules. Judge from the street_noon refcam at 2-6 m.

Generated buildings from 20-80 m: balconies with railings and furniture on midtown apartments, window AC units and satellite dishes, drainpipes and vents, roof edges' flashing, fire escapes, painted signs on side walls, a few windows open. Per-building hashes, the kit batch (per building) or the facade detail MultiMesh; LOD ring / far city untouched or cheaply mirrored. Measure with geo_count at the street_noon and golden_aerial refcams.

Trees under light: the crowns' self-shadowing and translucency on Forward+ (trees-closeup landed: finish on the scanned trees and the palms), shadows that read as a canopy on the ground (the shadow twin's density), the sway's weight (not a uniform wobble), the leaf cards' edges at 5-20 m. Judge on a small Forward+ scene under lavapipe at noon and golden hour.

Everything that stands on the ground meets it: ambient occlusion and contact shadow under cars (ContactShadows landed), bins, benches, people (a soft blob under each near pedestrian's feet), trees' trunks, planters, poles; darkened dirt / wear round the base of poles and hydrants (kerb_marks). No floating props: a probe that rays every FULL chunk prop to the ground and lists what floats more than 3 cm, then fix the placements.

The daytime sky at street level and from the air: the sun disc's size and glare, the horizon's brightness against the buildings (today often too bright and washes the frame), the cumulus volume's look at noon from the ground (bases, tops, their number), the haze gradient. Hold the sunset / dawn colours (dawn-review and rc-sunset own them): change only 09:00-16:00's sky and prove the other hours bit-identical with sky_shot.gd.

The water from the beach and the pier at 14:00 and 21:00: the near sea's colour, foam, glitter, transparency over the sand (ocean-closeup landed: finish), the reflections of the pier and its lamps at night, the swash's wet sand. Hold the far sea and the horizon plane's sea (aerial-review). Coordinate: rc-beach and rc-pier-night judge the whole frame; you own the ocean / beach_sand shaders. Prove on a small Forward+ scene.

The explosion and fire at arm's length, third pass: the fireball's volume (lit puffs with real depth, not cards), the smoke's shading under sun and at night, debris that bounces and comes to rest, sparks that land, the scorch and crater's edge, the light's falloff on the facades, heat haze. BlastFX / WeaponFX; keep the web's cheap path. Strips with tools/glshot/fx_shot.gd on both renderers.

The guns' feedback at arm's length: muzzle flash (volumetric, lights the hands and the wall), the smoke after a burst, the brass in flight, the recoil animation on the hero's arms and the camera, the impact decals' variety by surface, tracers' look, the shotgun's spread marks. WeaponFX / the weapons' _fire; strips with post_room_shot.gd MODE=fire and hero_shot.gd.

A police chase that reads like GTA: cruisers that box the player's car in, a PIT manoeuvre at speed, spike strips at a roadblock, officers that take cover behind doors and advance, a helicopter spotlight that tracks (AirTraffic's does), radio chatter (synthesised bleeps + CC0 voice if any; else none). PoliceCar / PoliceOfficer / Police; the smoke test keeps Police.enabled off except in your checks.

The wanted system's five stars as distinct: 1 a cruiser, 2 several, 3 the helicopter and roadblocks, 4 tactical vans and officers with rifles, 5 the whole city after you (army-style trucks of an invented agency, a gunship's spotlight). Each star's visual and audio signature (siren mix, radio). Police.gd caps per star; keep the police off in the smoke test except in your checks.

Crashes at speed: windows that burst in a spray of cubes on impact (not only when shot), bumpers that hang and drag with sparks, bonnets that fly open, airbags (a white bag in the cabin trace), a wheel torn off rolling away, the car's body rolling over realistically (centre of mass), debris that stays. CarDamage / CrashDeform; car_shot.gd DAMAGE= stills.

Ragdolls that read right: a shot person staggers before falling (a short hit reaction clip per direction, then the doll), a knocked person flies with their limbs trailing (joint damping), a body hit by a car wraps over the bonnet and slides off, a doll on stairs rolls down. RagdollJoints / Ragdoll / Pedestrian.knock; keep the max_active cap and the freeze.

Blood and gore at arm's length (the owner asked for more): wounds that read on the body (an entry hole decal on the character via the shader's wound uniforms: bigger, darker rim, glossy), blood that pools and spreads on the ground with the camber, drips off a body carried on a bonnet, splatter on the hero's clothes when close, the gib stumps. WeaponFX.blood / Ragdoll; keep the caps; stills with still_shot.gd FX_SHOOT.

The street's sound at eye level: footsteps of the crowd near the player, shop doors' bells, a dog's bark, the bus's air brakes, a car's door shutting when somebody gets in (StreetErrands), tyre noise by surface, the wind in the trees, the sea's distance. Ambience / Sfx with CC0 clips (docs/ASSETS.md), the loudness table rule, the bus routing. Checks on levels_for / rates_for purity.

Street lamps at night at eye level: the lamp heads' glare and halo size, the pools' shape and colour (sodium vs LED per patch), the shadows under cars and people from the nearest lamps (the OmniLights cast none: a budgeted shadow on the nearest two on HIGH), the lit faces of the facades. NightAtmos / StreetLamps / DayNight.lamp_scale; a small Forward+ scene under lavapipe; hold the night refcam's numbers within tolerance.

The traced rooms behind windows, second pass: residential rooms in the apartments and houses at night (a TV's flicker, a lamp, a figure walking past), offices with people at desks by day, curtains and blinds variety, the odd open window with a curtain moving. building.gdshader room_interior / house_glass / apartments; integer rolls, near and far agreeing.

The first minute of play: the loading screen's time (LoadClock), what pops in after the shade lifts (chunks still building, the far city tiles, traffic filling), the first-use stutters (WarmRehearsal: anything new in wave 3 that compiles on first sight). Measure on both renderers with tools/load_time and shader_warm; fix the three biggest.

Frame cost after wave 3: run tools/geo_count.gd and still_shot.gd SPLIT=1 at the ten refcams, list the ten most expensive systems per camera, and cut what is over budget without a visible change (DIFF=1 pairs, img_diff.py). Targets: triangles and draws at each camera back under the wave-2 numbers in tools/refcams' report. Memory: peak RSS under 3,600 MB in the gate.

The gate's intermittent failures: run `SHARDS=3 tests/headless_check.sh` five times in a row on main (SMOKE_SHUFFLE=<seed> with a different seed each run), collect every FAIL and script error, and fix each cause (a check that leans on a live system, a race between shards, a tolerance too tight for a soft constraint) so five runs pass clean. Report the list. CI 394's four were fixed on main already (traffic _group_clear, heli strike in clear air, wildlife staged on the pavement, the ragdoll box).

Forward+ review of what wave 3's batches 21-25 merged (aerial-review, lawns-closeup, web-review-3, house-nights, car-paint-2, night-street-review, street-clutter-2, downtown-street-closeup, storm-drama, golden-hour-review): shoot each on a small Forward+ scene under lavapipe (block_shot.tscn, the room tools) and fix what the opengl3 stills hid (colour space, additive clipping, SSR, volumetric fog). The handoff's fwd-review-d / e notes list the traps.

The web build after batch 25: export it, load every bookmark in tools/webshot (ONE tab at a time), fix any shader / WebGL / global-buffer error and anything that reads wrong there (except the hero in rain: web-hero-rain owns that), keep the pck under 650 MB (the exclude filter), update tests/web_build_checks.gd.

The owner's Mac is the only true Forward+ check and nobody has seen wave 3 there. Build a one-key verification pack for the owner: a `--verify` launch mode (or pause-menu button) that teleports through the ten reference cameras at their hours, holds each 3 s, saves a PNG of each to Pictures/Rando Game/verify_<build>/ and a sheet, and shows a card at the end; plus a docs/VERIFY.md page telling the owner exactly what to do and what to send back. No new render features.
